historical_claim: modern synthesis; original renderings, not a translation

hexagrams.name: The Creative
hexagrams.judgment: Sublime success. Persevere in the right, and the way opens before you like the open sky.
hexagrams.meaning: Pure creative force; the time favors bold, principled action.

hexagrams.name: The Receptive
hexagrams.judgment: Sublime success through devotion. Yield, serve, and follow the lead of what is right, as the earth bears all things.
hexagrams.meaning: Receptive endurance; strength lies in support, patience, and quiet persistence.

hexagrams.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
hexagrams.judgment: Sublime success, but do not force the issue. Gather helpers and lay foundations while the sprout is still tender.
hexagrams.meaning: Birth-pangs of a new undertaking; chaos that will resolve with steady care.

hexagrams.name: Youthful Folly
hexagrams.judgment: It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. Ask with sincerity and teaching will come; ask in jest and it will not.
hexagrams.meaning: Inexperience needing guidance; learn before you act.

hexagrams.name: Waiting
hexagrams.judgment: If you are sincere, waiting brings light and success. Do not cross the great water yet; the time ripens of itself.
hexagrams.meaning: Patient, confident waiting; nourishment comes to those who do not rush.

hexagrams.name: Conflict
hexagrams.judgment: There is sincerity, but also obstruction. Turn back midway and seek the great person; crossing the great water now brings no gain.
hexagrams.meaning: Dispute and contention; seek mediation rather than victory.

hexagrams.name: The Army
hexagrams.judgment: The army needs perseverance and a strong leader. If the cause is just and the commander worthy, there is no blame.
hexagrams.meaning: Disciplined collective effort under firm, just leadership.

hexagrams.name: Holding Together
hexagrams.judgment: Good fortune. Hold to the source of union with sincerity; those who come late meet misfortune.
hexagrams.meaning: Alliance and belonging; choose your fellowship with care and loyalty.

hexagrams.name: Small Taming
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Dense clouds gather but no rain falls yet; gentle restraint stores strength for the moment of release.
hexagrams.meaning: Minor restraint; small accumulations preparing a greater advance.

hexagrams.name: Treading
hexagrams.judgment: Treading on the tiger's tail: it does not bite. Conduct yourself with care and there is success.
hexagrams.meaning: Careful conduct in delicate circumstances; courtesy disarms danger.

hexagrams.name: Peace
hexagrams.judgment: The small departs, the great approaches. Good fortune and success; heaven and earth in communion.
hexagrams.meaning: Harmony and flourishing; all things in their proper, fruitful order.

hexagrams.name: Standstill
hexagrams.judgment: The great departs, the small approaches. Preserve your integrity and do not strive; the noble endures the standstill.
hexagrams.meaning: Stagnation and blockage; withdraw and keep your integrity intact.

hexagrams.name: Fellowship
hexagrams.judgment: Success in the open field. It furthers one to cross the great water; the noble person's perseverance brings gain.
hexagrams.meaning: Fellowship with others in a common cause; unity of purpose.

hexagrams.name: Great Possession
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme success. Great holdings rightly kept bring honor and lasting good.
hexagrams.meaning: Abundance held with generosity and restraint; prosperity rightly managed.

hexagrams.name: Modesty
hexagrams.judgment: Success. The noble person carries things through by modesty; the lowly is exalted and the proud brought down.
hexagrams.meaning: Humility as strength; the modest one completes the work.

hexagrams.name: Enthusiasm
hexagrams.judgment: It furthers one to appoint helpers and set things in motion. Enthusiasm moves others when it is sincere.
hexagrams.meaning: Joyful readiness and inspiration; the music that sets people moving.

hexagrams.name: Following
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme success. Perseverance brings no blame; follow what is right and timely, and others will follow you.
hexagrams.meaning: Adaptation and timely following; go with the current of what is true.

hexagrams.name: Decay / Work on the Decayed
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme success. It furthers one to cross the great water; weigh three days before the turning and three days after.
hexagrams.meaning: Corruption to be repaired; deliberate work restores what was neglected.

hexagrams.name: Approach
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme success. What approaches must be met rightly while the tide is high; in the eighth month, misfortune.
hexagrams.meaning: A favorable approach; guide what comes with dignified condescension.

hexagrams.name: Contemplation
hexagrams.judgment: The cleansing is done but not yet the offering; with full sincerity, contemplate — and let yourself be contemplated.
hexagrams.meaning: Observation and reflection; the example set by quiet, reverent watching.

hexagrams.name: Biting Through
hexagrams.judgment: Success. It furthers one to apply the law; bite through the obstruction and the way clears.
hexagrams.meaning: Decisive action against obstruction; justice that removes what blocks.

hexagrams.name: Grace
hexagrams.judgment: Success, but little gain in going far. Grace adorns without carrying weight; attend to substance beneath the form.
hexagrams.meaning: Beauty and ornament; form that should serve substance, not replace it.

hexagrams.name: Splitting Apart
hexagrams.judgment: It does not further one to go anywhere. The lower splits away the higher; hold fast and do not contend.
hexagrams.meaning: Erosion and decay; endure quietly while the tide of dissolution passes.

hexagrams.name: Return
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Going out and coming in without error; friends arrive, and the way of return brings no blame.
hexagrams.meaning: The turning point; renewal after decline, the light returning.

hexagrams.name: Innocence
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme success when the heart is true. If your intent strays from what is right, misfortune follows; act without artifice.
hexagrams.meaning: Naturalness and sincerity without calculation; follow the heart, not the scheme.

hexagrams.name: Great Taming
hexagrams.judgment: Perseverance brings gain. Do not eat at home; cross the great water — great restraint gathers great power.
hexagrams.meaning: Strong restraint accumulating force; study and discipline storing up energy.

hexagrams.name: Nourishment
hexagrams.judgment: Perseverance brings good fortune. Watch what you nourish and how you seek nourishment; the jaws reveal the person.
hexagrams.meaning: Care of body and spirit; what feeds you shapes what you become.

hexagrams.name: Great Excess
hexagrams.judgment: The ridgepole sags. It furthers one to have somewhere to go; extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures.
hexagrams.meaning: Excess and strain beyond the norm; the beam bends — act decisively or it breaks.

hexagrams.name: The Abysmal
hexagrams.judgment: If you are sincere, the heart succeeds. Move forward in sincerity and your conduct gains honor even amid danger.
hexagrams.meaning: Repeated danger; the abyss crossed by sincerity and steady courage.

hexagrams.name: The Clinging
hexagrams.judgment: Perseverance in the right brings success; tending the cow brings good fortune — cling to the light.
hexagrams.meaning: Clarity and attachment to what illuminates; brightness that depends on its fuel.

hexagrams.name: Influence
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Perseverance brings gain; sincere feeling moves all — influence works through the heart.
hexagrams.meaning: Mutual attraction and resonance; the stirring that moves hearts together.

hexagrams.name: Duration
hexagrams.judgment: Success, no blame. Perseverance brings gain; it furthers one to have somewhere to go — endure in the right way.
hexagrams.meaning: Constancy and lasting commitment; the long road held without wavering.

hexagrams.name: Retreat
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Slight perseverance brings gain; the noble one withdraws in dignity before the inferior advance.
hexagrams.meaning: Strategic withdrawal; retreat with honor rather than contend in vain.

hexagrams.name: Great Power
hexagrams.judgment: Perseverance brings gain, but great strength must follow rightness — lest the ram butt the hedge and entangle its horns.
hexagrams.meaning: Great strength that must be tempered; power rightly directed, not recklessly spent.

hexagrams.name: Progress
hexagrams.judgment: The prince is honored with many horses and received in audience day after day; advance brings reward.
hexagrams.meaning: Advancement and recognition; rising like the sun through merit.

hexagrams.name: Darkening of the Light
hexagrams.judgment: In adversity it furthers one to persevere. Hide your brightness and endure; the light is wounded but not extinguished.
hexagrams.meaning: The light obscured by darkness; protect your inner clarity in hard times.

hexagrams.name: The Family
hexagrams.judgment: The woman's perseverance brings gain; order within brings order without — the family is the root of the state.
hexagrams.meaning: The household rightly ordered; duty and affection in their proper places.

hexagrams.name: Opposition
hexagrams.judgment: In small matters, good fortune. Opposition need not be enmity; where views diverge, lesser things can still succeed.
hexagrams.meaning: Estrangement and contrary views; find the small common ground.

hexagrams.name: Obstruction
hexagrams.judgment: The southwest furthers, the northeast does not. It furthers one to see the great person; perseverance brings good fortune amid the lame advance.
hexagrams.meaning: Obstruction and difficulty; turn inward and seek wise counsel.

hexagrams.name: Deliverance
hexagrams.judgment: The southwest furthers. Where there is nowhere left to go, return brings good fortune; where there is somewhere to go, hasten — the tension releases.
hexagrams.meaning: Release from tension; forgiveness and the loosening of bonds.

hexagrams.name: Decrease
hexagrams.judgment: With sincerity there is supreme good fortune and no blame. Decrease what is excessive to serve what is higher.
hexagrams.meaning: Sacrifice and simplification; giving up the lesser to strengthen the greater.

hexagrams.name: Increase
hexagrams.judgment: It furthers one to undertake something and to cross the great water; increase flows to the sincere.
hexagrams.meaning: Growth and benefit; wind and thunder strengthening each other.

hexagrams.name: Breakthrough
hexagrams.judgment: Resolutely proclaim the matter at the court. There is danger; warn your own city and do not take up arms.
hexagrams.meaning: Resolute breakthrough; the decision spoken openly at the decisive moment.

hexagrams.name: Coming to Meet
hexagrams.judgment: The maiden is strong; do not wed such a maiden. What comes to meet you unbidden must be met with firmness.
hexagrams.meaning: An unexpected encounter; the yielding meets the strong — meet it with resolve.

hexagrams.name: Gathering Together
hexagrams.judgment: Success. The king approaches the temple; see the great person and undertake something — sincerity gathers all.
hexagrams.meaning: Assembly and union; people drawn together around a worthy center.

hexagrams.name: Pushing Upward
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme success. See the great person and have no fear; set forth southward — steady ascent brings good fortune.
hexagrams.meaning: Gradual, steady rise; the sprout pushing upward through patient effort.

hexagrams.name: Oppression
hexagrams.judgment: Success through perseverance. The great person brings good fortune by steadfastness; in oppression, hold to truth in silence.
hexagrams.meaning: Exhaustion and constraint; dignity maintained when resources fail.

hexagrams.name: The Well
hexagrams.judgment: The town may change, but the well cannot be changed. It neither decreases nor increases; draw, and it is ever full.
hexagrams.meaning: The inexhaustible common source; the deep resource that serves all.

hexagrams.name: Revolution
hexagrams.judgment: On your own day you are believed. Supreme success when the change is timely and just; remorse disappears.
hexagrams.meaning: Radical transformation; the old skin shed when the season is ripe.

hexagrams.name: The Cauldron
hexagrams.judgment: Supreme good fortune and success. The sacred vessel nourishes the wise and sustains the state; take up the new order.
hexagrams.meaning: The vessel of transformation; nourishment refined into culture and stability.

hexagrams.name: The Arousing
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Thunder comes with terror, yet one remains smiling and composed; it startles a hundred miles and the ladle is not spilled.
hexagrams.meaning: Shocking movement that awakens; terror that clears the air and restores order.

hexagrams.name: Keeping Still
hexagrams.judgment: Keeping the back still, he no longer feels the body; walking the courtyard, he does not see the people — no blame in true stillness.
hexagrams.meaning: Stillness and meditation; rest in what is right, unmoved by externals.

hexagrams.name: Development
hexagrams.judgment: The maiden marries with good fortune; perseverance brings gain — advance step by step like the wild geese.
hexagrams.meaning: Gradual, orderly progress; each stage secured before the next.

hexagrams.name: The Marrying Maiden
hexagrams.judgment: Undertakings bring misfortune; nothing is furthered — the maiden marries out of order, and impropriety spoils the union.
hexagrams.meaning: An ill-suited or improper union; desire outrunning right order.

hexagrams.name: Abundance
hexagrams.judgment: Success. The king attains it; be not sad but like the sun at midday — abundance at its peak must be guarded.
hexagrams.meaning: Fullness at its zenith; greatness that must be sustained with care.

hexagrams.name: The Wanderer
hexagrams.judgment: Slight success. The wanderer's perseverance brings good fortune — travel light, be courteous, hold to the right.
hexagrams.meaning: The sojourner far from home; humility and adaptability on the road.

hexagrams.name: The Gentle
hexagrams.judgment: Slight success. It furthers one to have somewhere to go and to see the great person; gentle penetration prevails.
hexagrams.meaning: Gentle, persistent influence; the wind that wears away resistance.

hexagrams.name: The Joyous
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Perseverance brings gain; joy shared in sincerity binds hearts together.
hexagrams.meaning: Joy and open exchange; gladness that gathers friends.

hexagrams.name: Dispersion
hexagrams.judgment: Success. The king approaches the temple; cross the great water and persevere — dissolve what has congealed.
hexagrams.meaning: Dissolution of blockage; scattering the frozen, reuniting the scattered.

hexagrams.name: Limitation
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Bitter limitation must not be persevered in; set the right measure and there is no blame.
hexagrams.meaning: Boundaries and measure; the right limit protects, the bitter one strangles.

hexagrams.name: Inner Truth
hexagrams.judgment: Even dolphins and pigs are moved: good fortune. Cross the great water; perseverance brings gain — sincerity reaches the distant.
hexagrams.meaning: Inner sincerity; truthfulness that moves hearts across every divide.

hexagrams.name: Small Excess
hexagrams.judgment: Success. Perseverance brings gain; do small things, not great ones — the bird ascends in song but descends in rest.
hexagrams.meaning: Modest overstepping in small matters; humility in ambition, care in detail.

hexagrams.name: After Completion
hexagrams.judgment: Success in small matters; perseverance brings gain. At the beginning good fortune, at the end disorder — guard what is complete.
hexagrams.meaning: Order achieved; the work done — stay vigilant, lest success unravel.

hexagrams.name: Before Completion
hexagrams.judgment: Success. The young fox nearly crosses but wets its tail; no direction brings gain yet — the end is near, hold steady.
hexagrams.meaning: The work not yet done; the final step demands the greatest care.
